target_rule: Same external one-to-one IoU>=.5 candidate GT matches and immutable actual old actor birth IDs; correct-existing alias set, otherwise original NEW/IGNORE/NO_MATCH contract. GT never repairs model or actor state.
comparison: All models receive exact same original actor pre-write tensors. Compare typed identity argmax and one-step global Hungarian assignments; only original actor evolves. This is a conditional decision diagnosis, not a new continuous rollout or HOTA.
validation: Recomputed original full outputs and state must equal every saved original frame exactly; original shadow Hungarian choices must reproduce every actual original candidate event.
storage: Only compressed posthoc decisions and summaries, no image/ROI feature copies; 2MiB metadata suballocation within existing16MiB Compact reservation.
